selection.warning: Projected stellar half-mass radius against total stellar mass for DARWIN-1 galaxies at z = 4.5: the median (solid grey) with the 16th and 84th percentiles (dashed grey), read from the vector paths of Lee et al. 2026; the three curves share their mass grid. Galaxies are projected on the XY plane of the box. The DARWIN-1 resolution limit is 500 pc (log R = -0.3, dotted line); sizes below a few resolution elements are not reliable (the paper says the low-mass sizes are probably resolution-limited and larger than observed).
